import sys

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import create_task, remove_tasks, rename_task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def _run(monkeypatch, *argv):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", *argv])
    cli.main()


def test_remove_tasks_archives_all_given(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("a", 60)
    b = create_task("b", 60)
    c = create_task("c", 60)
    assert remove_tasks([a.id, c.id, 99]) == 2
    assert [(t.title, t.archived) for t in load_all()] == [
        ("a", True), ("b", False), ("c", True)]


def test_rm_cli(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("a", 60)
    b = create_task("b", 60)
    _run(monkeypatch, "rm", str(a.id), str(b.id))
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "2"
    assert all(t.archived for t in load_all())


def test_rename_task(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", 60)
    assert rename_task(t.id, "  new  ") is True
    assert load_all()[0].title == "  new  "  # api stores as given
    assert rename_task(99, "x") is False


def test_rename_cli_normalizes(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", 60)
    _run(monkeypatch, "rename", str(t.id), "  new   title ")
    assert load_all()[0].title == "new title"
    _run(monkeypatch, "rename", "99", "x")
    assert "no such task" in capsys.readouterr().out

def dedupe_tasks() -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) tasks sharing an exact title, keeping the earliest due_at.

    Already-archived tasks are ignored. Ties keep the lowest id. Returns the number archived.
    """
    tasks = load_all()

    for t in tasks:
        if t.archived:

        best = keep.get(t.title)
        if best is None or t.due_at < best.due_at:
            keep[t.title] = t
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if not t.archived and keep[t.title] is not t:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count

            new = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=t.due_at)
            tasks.append(new)
            save_all(tasks)
            return new

import sys

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import copy_task, create_task, dedupe_tasks
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, save_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def _run(monkeypatch, *argv):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", *argv])
    cli.main()


def test_dedupe_keeps_earliest_due_and_archives_rest(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("a", 300)
    create_task("a", 100)
    create_task("a", 200)
    create_task("b", 50)
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 2
    assert [(t.title, t.archived) for t in load_all()] == [
        ("a", True), ("a", False), ("a", True), ("b", False)]
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 0


def test_dedupe_ignores_archived_and_is_exact(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("a", 100)
    create_task("A", 200)
    create_task("a", 300)
    tasks = load_all()
    tasks[0].archived = True
    save_all(tasks)
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 0


def test_dedupe_cli(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("x", 10)
    create_task("x", 20)
    _run(monkeypatch, "dedupe")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "1"
    assert [t.archived for t in load_all()] == [False, True]


def test_copy_task_same_due_at(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("orig", 60)
    c = copy_task(t.id, "orig (copy)")
    assert c.id != t.id and c.due_at == t.due_at and c.title == "orig (copy)"
    assert copy_task(99, "x") is None


def test_copy_cli(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("  my   task ", 60)
    _run(monkeypatch, "copy", str(t.id))
    new = load_all()[1]
    assert new.title == "my task (copy)"
    assert new.due_at == t.due_at
    _run(monkeypatch, "copy", "99")
    assert "no such task" in capsys.readouterr().out

import sys

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import copy_task, create_task, dedupe_tasks
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, save_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def _run(monkeypatch, *argv):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", *argv])
    cli.main()


def test_dedupe_keeps_earliest_due_and_archives_rest(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("a", 300)
    create_task("a", 100)
    create_task("a", 200)
    create_task("b", 50)
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 2
    assert [(t.title, t.archived) for t in load_all()] == [
        ("a", True), ("a", False), ("a", True), ("b", False)]
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 0


def test_dedupe_ignores_archived_and_is_exact(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("a", 100)
    create_task("A", 200)
    create_task("a", 300)
    tasks = load_all()
    tasks[0].archived = True
    save_all(tasks)
    assert dedupe_tasks() == 0


def test_dedupe_cli(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("x", 10)
    create_task("x", 20)
    _run(monkeypatch, "dedupe")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "1"
    assert [t.archived for t in load_all()] == [False, True]


def test_copy_task_same_due_at(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("orig", 60)
    c = copy_task(t.id, "orig (copy)")
    assert c.id != t.id and c.due_at == t.due_at and c.title == "orig (copy)"
    assert copy_task(99, "x") is None


def test_copy_cli(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("  my   task ", 60)
    _run(monkeypatch, "copy", str(t.id))
    new = load_all()[1]
    assert new.title == "my task (copy)"
    assert new.due_at == t.due_at
    _run(monkeypatch, "copy", "99")
    assert "no such task" in capsys.readouterr().out
EOF
